title: Divorce Attorney Google Ads: County-Level Case Value

facts.fact: Segarra & Associates, P.A. ran $2,500 a month in Google Ads across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties.
facts.quote: Segarra & Associates, P.A. ran $2,500 a month across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach, producing about 50 leads a month at roughly $50 each.

facts.fact: The Segarra & Associates Google Ads campaign produced about 50 leads a month at roughly $50 cost per lead.
facts.quote: producing about 50 leads a month at roughly $50 each.

facts.fact: Of the leads in the Segarra & Associates campaign, about 30 came by phone call and about 20 through contact forms.
Sixty percent of Segarra & Associates leads arrived by phone and forty percent by form.
facts.quote: Sixty percent of leads came by phone and forty percent by form

facts.fact: The Segarra & Associates engagement lasted one year at $2,500 per month.

Segarra & Associates reported that matters originating in Palm Beach tended to involve clients with more substantial assets and more substantial cases, while cost per lead stayed roughly the same across the three counties.
facts.quote: The firm reported that matters originating in Palm Beach tended to involve clients with more substantial assets, and correspondingly more substantial cases.

facts.fact: The Segarra campaign was structured with a separate campaign for each of the three counties rather than one South Florida target, and the firm states this costs nothing extra.
facts.quote: Each county given its own campaign rather than one South Florida target. It costs nothing extra to structure this way

facts.fact: The Segarra account split divorce and custody into separate campaigns with their own messaging.
facts.quote: The two practice areas given their own campaigns and messaging

facts.fact: The vendor states it does not publish per-county lead or case value figures for this account.
facts.quote: We don't publish per county lead or case value figures, we don't hold them.

facts.fact: The vendor's audit offer is free and requires read-only account access.
facts.quote: Read only access · No obligation · You keep your accounts
